title: Hardrock 100 results on OpenSplitTime (official timing platform)
publisher: OpenSplitTime, linked from the Hardrock 100 homepage
claims: The Hardrock 100 homepage directs runners to OpenSplitTime for the year's results; the 2026 results entry sits under the '2026 Results & Photos' section.
